title: Taskmaster Mirot and the reanimated minions
summary: Taskmaster Mirot and his reanimated minions fight as a linked group.
overview: Taskmaster Mirot and his reanimated minions fight as a linked group.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: The quest sequence summons Mirot with six minions. Engaging either the taskmaster or a minion pulls other linked opponents into combat.
Minions taken more than 200 units from Mirot are brought back to him. Plan to control the group nearby rather than splitting them across the forest.
The summoned taskmaster has a thirty-minute cleanup timer. Finish the fight and recover the quest objective within that window.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
